subject: Hosted API evaluation — next steps & quickstart

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 14 Feb 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Hosted API evaluation — quick recap & next steps

Thanks for taking the demo today, Evan — great conversation.

Quick recap from our side:
- You want low-friction integration to validate latency and cost for the payments support assistant use case.
- Primary constraint: must be able to start on Hosted API (fast) with the option to move to Dedicated capacity if throughput needs grow.
- Security note: initial proof-of-concept can run on Hosted API; for production you may require VPC/private deployment depending on audit findings.

Next steps I propose:
1) I'll send a quickstart bundle (API endpoints, sample curl calls, and a small postman collection).
2) You and engineering run a short smoke test (recommend 48-72 hours) against Hosted API to validate end-to-end latency and token usage.
3) We reconvene to review results and, if needed, scope Dedicated capacity sizing or Private deployment.

Attached: redwood-hosted-quickstart.pdf and a short rate-limits spreadsheet.

If you need a short SRE/SE pairing session during the smoke test we can have Rishi jump in.

Best,
Marissa

Thanks Marissa — that all sounds good. A couple quick clarifications before we spin up the POC:

- On Hosted API vs Dedicated: our security team will push back if PII is stored long-term, but for the assist bot POC they're OK with Hosted if we can confirm data retention policies and logging controls.
- What are the default rate limits and how do they apply to burst traffic? We expect 50 concurrent agents with short prompts (avg 120 tokens) for initial tests.
- Do you provide a time-limited API key or trial credits? Procurement will need that info to track costs.

Cc'ing procurement so they see the ask. If you can send the quickstart and a short note about logging/retention and rate limits, we'll get infra to run the smoke test.

—Evan

Acme Payments

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Procurement <procurement@acme-payments.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Feb 2026 11:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted API evaluation — quick recap & next steps

Thanks Evan — answers inline below.

- Data retention / logging: Hosted API retains request logs for 30 days by default; logs can be disabled for specific API keys, and we offer an enterprise retention add-on. No customer data is used to train models. I'm attaching the short SOC2/data-retention excerpt in the quickstart PDF.

- Rate limits: Default tier for Hosted API is 60 requests per minute and 200 tokens/sec per project, with burst handling at short intervals. For your expected 50 concurrent agents (avg 120 tokens), that maps to ~6000 TPS of tokens; we recommend a Dedicated or Reserved pool if you need sustained concurrency at that scale. For the smoke test, we can temporarily raise rate limits on your project for 72 hours — Rishi can coordinate.

- Trial credits / API keys: We can issue a time-limited API key and $1,000 worth of test credits for the POC. Procurement: if that works, Marissa here will generate the key and start the eval project.

Attachments: redwood-hosted-quickstart.pdf (includes curl examples, endpoints, and a sample rate-limits sheet). Also attaching a short spreadsheet redwood-rate-limits.xlsx with token math.

Next step: Evan — if you confirm you want the temporary rate bump + test credits I'll create the project and send creds + Postman collection.

Thanks,
Marissa
